file_id: An Application For Bail Under Section ... vs Manik Rui Das on 3 March, 2020

sentences.text:
An Application For Bail Under Section ... vs Manik Rui Das on 3
March, 2020
 1
132 03.03.2020
ss Rejected
 C.R.M. 4618 of 2019
In the matter of : An application for bail under section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure filed
on 30.05.2019 in connection with Moyna P.S. Case No. 227 of 2015 dated 28.09.2015 under sections
272/273 of the Indian Penal Code read with West Bengal Act 42 of 1973 and sections 3/304/120B of
the Indian Penal Code and section 46Aa of the Bengal Excise Act and section 16(3) of the Prevention
of Food Adulteration Act.

And In the matter of : Manik Rui Das Mr. Imtiaz Ahmed Sk. Saidullah Mr. S. Banerjee ... ... for the petitioner Mr. Sanjoy Bardhan Mr. Palash Chandra Majhi ... ... for the State Report is placed on record.
It appears that trial has substantially progressed.
In view of the aforesaid development, we are not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.
The application for bail is, thus, rejected.
Trial court, however, is directed to expedite the trial and conclude the same at an early date without granting unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties.

(Suvra Ghosh, J.) (Joymalya Bagchi, J.)
